arguments.summary: Critical ransomware incident initiated via phishing compromise of user CORP\jsmith on host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.14). Attack involved execution of a malicious PowerShell payload leading to Cobalt Strike beacon deployment (SHA256: a1b2c3d4...). The adversary performed lateral movement via SMB to multiple internal systems, including a file server. C2 communication was established with external IP 198.51.100.23. Immediate containment actions included network isolation of the infected host and C2 server, revocation of the compromised user account, and execution of a hardening playbook. No evidence of ransomware binary execution or encryption was found during post-containment scans.
